principle: Different English and Kiswahili token counts are not errors by themselves. Only loss or alteration of an objective policy invariant requires correction.

reviewed_items.reason: The quantity 1 and the pair relationship are preserved.
The English ordinal is part of the term third party, not a policy quantity.
Kiswahili does not pluralise the technical acronym PNR with an English suffix.
The ordinal fifth is expressed naturally as Tano rather than the digit form 5th.
